# smplkit_flag (Data Source)

Read a smplkit flag by id. `default`, value `value` entries, and rule `logic`/`value` are returned as JSON-encoded strings.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "smplkit_flag" "dark_mode" {
  id = "dark_mode"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The flag key.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) RFC3339 creation timestamp.
- `default` (String) JSON-encoded default value.
- `description` (String) Optional description.
- `environments` (Attributes Map) Per-environment overrides. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--environments))
- `name` (String) Display name.
- `type` (String) Flag type: BOOLEAN, STRING, NUMERIC, or JSON.
- `updated_at` (String) RFC3339 last-modified timestamp.
- `values` (Attributes List) Optional constrained value set. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--values))

<a id="nestedatt--environments"></a>
### Nested Schema for `environments`

Read-Only:

- `default` (String) Environment-specific default (JSON-encoded).
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the flag is evaluated in this environment.
- `rules` (Attributes List) Ordered list of JSON Logic targeting rules. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--environments--rules))

<a id="nestedatt--environments--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `environments.rules`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Human-readable description.
- `logic` (String) JSON Logic expression (JSON-encoded).
- `value` (String) Value served on match (JSON-encoded).



<a id="nestedatt--values"></a>
### Nested Schema for `values`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) Display label.
- `value` (String) JSON-encoded value.
